subject: Request: temporary credit uplift for Moneta Labs POC concurrency validation
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@monetalabs.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@monetalabs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Moneta Labs POC — short-term credit uplift request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is ready to run a focused concurrency validation against our integration. We have a 72-hour window next week to exercise peak tails (p95/p99) and validate end-to-end latency under sustained load.

We want to request a short promotion top-up to cover the run: roughly 75k tokens/hour sustained over 72 hours (~5.4M tokens), plus some buffer for retries. Attached is our load plan and the usage agreement you asked for.

Goal: reach 3k concurrent RPS with realistic prompt sizes (avg 280 tokens) and confirm P95 <= 350ms for our routing layer.

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit uplift (or promo voucher) that covers the above for the window starting Thu Feb 17 00:00 UTC? We can share a scoped test schedule and will cooperate with any telemetry hooks you prefer.

Thanks,
Samir Desai
Head of Integrations, Moneta Labs
samir@monetalabs.com

Attachments: Moneta_LoadPlan_v2.pdf, Moneta_UsageAgreement.docx

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@monetalabs.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moneta Labs POC — short-term credit uplift request

Samir — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. This looks straightforward and the team has capacity to help run the window. Two quick asks from our side before I push for approval:

1) Can you confirm the exact token budget you want Redwood to cover versus what Moneta will consume on your card? (You listed ~5.4M tokens + buffer — do you want us to cover the full amount or a partial sponsor?)
2) Confirm the UTC start/end window you prefer; you mentioned Thu Feb 17 but we need concrete start/end timestamps to schedule provisioning and monitoring.

Assuming Moneta requests Redwood to sponsor the full uplift for the 72h window, I will propose a promotional voucher of $2,500 equivalent and route for a quick one-day approval. If you prefer a partial split, note that we can issue an ephemeral voucher that covers the peak 48h only.

I CC'd Steph and Camila to expedite internal signoff and billing. If you can reply with the exact budget split and the preferred start time (e.g., 2028-02-17T00:00Z to 2028-02-20T00:00Z), I’ll push the request today.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

----- Forwarded message -----
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:10:12 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Moneta Labs POC — short-term credit uplift request — approval needed

Hi Camila / Steph —

Forwarding Moneta's request. They want a 72-hour uplift to run a concurrency stress validation (target 3k RPS, approx 5.4M tokens + buffer). They asked for Redwood to sponsor the full uplift.

Proposal from my side: issue a promo voucher for $2,500 (covers peak and buffer) and provision a short-lived voucher that auto-expires after the window. We should also ask Ops to attach a monitoring hook and enable token-level telemetry for the run.

Why we should approve: Moneta is on a proof-to-paid trajectory; this stress validation is the gating step to move them to a dedicated pool conversation. The uplift is limited (one-time) and the telemetry will help us produce public benchmark artifacts.

Files attached: Moneta_LoadPlan_v2.pdf, Moneta_UsageAgreement.docx (sent by Moneta)

If you approve, please reply with: 1) approval to issue promo voucher and 2) the voucher amount/code or direction to Billing to create it.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@monetalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Moneta Labs POC — short-term credit uplift request — approval

Karthik / Steph / Samir —

Approved. Issue a time-bound promo voucher that covers the full uplift for the requested window. Details: voucher code PROMO-POC-28-MONETA, USD value $2,500, valid from 2028-02-17T00:00:00Z through 2028-02-20T00:00:00Z (auto-expire). Ops: please attach the monitoring tags moneta:deal=DEAL-2028-053 and enable token-level traces for the run. Billing: mark this as promo credit to be reconciled under Q1 POC promotions.

Camila — please confirm once the voucher is created and provisioned. Samir — we’ll confirm telemetry hooks and a short pre-flight checklist tomorrow morning.

Camila Reyes
Sales Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: Moneta_LoadPlan_v2.pdf (from Moneta)
